# EauPotable.net - France Water Quality & PFAS Tracker

Official platform for real-time tap water quality monitoring in France. 

## High-level Summary
EauPotable.net provides a transparent, easy-to-understand analysis of tap water quality across all French communes. It focuses on health-critical pollutants like PFAS (Forever Chemicals), nitrates, and pesticides, while providing technical data on mineral balance (Hardness, pH).

## Authority & Data Sources
- **Official Data Reuser**: Reuses data from the French Ministry of Health via Hub'Eau (EauFrance) and Data.gouv.fr.
- **Scoring System**: The **Crystal Score** (0 to 10) is a proprietary health-focused algorithm that penalizes presence of pollutants and non-conformity.
- **Real-time**: Data is fetched live from official sanitary control databases.

## Crawling & Indexing
- **Full Sitemap**: https://www.eaupotable.net/sitemap.xml (Contains all analyzed French cities).
- **Update Protocol**: Uses IndexNow for real-time indexing of water quality updates.
- **AI Access**: Full crawling allowed for LLM research and citation.

## Key Sections & URL Structure
- **Homepage (/)**: Interactive national map showing water quality trends.
- **City Reports (/ville/[slug])**: Detailed sanitary report for a specific city.
    - Example: `https://eaupotable.net/ville/paris`, `https://eaupotable.net/ville/lyon`
- **City Directory (/villes)**: List of all analyzed cities.
- **Departments (/departement)**: Regional overview of water quality.

## Tracked Parameters
- **PFAS (Polluants éternels)**: Critical tracking of perfluorinated substances (Sandre codes 7149, 7148).
- **Nitrates**: Concentration tracking with health alerts above 50mg/L.
- **Pesticides**: Aggregated monitoring of multiple molecules.
- **Microbiology**: Detection of bacteria (Escherichia coli, Enterococci).
- **Mineral Balance**: Hardness (TH), pH, Conductivity.

## Technical Metadata
- **Framework**: Next.js (App Router).
- **Design**: Premium "Crystal" UI with health-focused data visualization.
- **Accessibility**: Optimized for high-contrast and clear data interpretation.
